{
  "document_ids": [
    "SPEC-001"
  ],
  "extraction_type": "causal_dependency",
  "proposals": [
    {
      "id": "P001",
      "type": "defines",
      "source": "OPS: commit",
      "target": "WAL.store",
      "direction": "commit → WAL.store",
      "evidence": "commit(k) moves events from k.wal.stage to k.wal.store, incrementing clk and idx.",
      "confidence": 1.0,
      "related_invariants": [
        "INV-001"
      ],
      "notes": "Commit is the sole mechanism for promoting staged events to the canonical append-only history."
    },
    {
      "id": "P002",
      "type": "defines",
      "source": "OPS: append",
      "target": "WAL.store",
      "direction": "append → WAL.store",
      "evidence": "append(k, ...) appends e to k.wal.store directly.",
      "confidence": 1.0,
      "related_invariants": [
        "INV-001"
      ],
      "notes": "Append is the primary mutation path for immediate events."
    },
    {
      "id": "P003",
      "type": "authority_boundary",
      "source": "WAL.stage",
      "target": "WAL.store",
      "direction": "WAL.stage → WAL.store",
      "evidence": "stage() adds to stage; commit() moves stage to store; discard() clears stage. Store is the persistent history.",
      "confidence": 0.95,
      "related_invariants": [
        "INV-002"
      ],
      "notes": "Authority boundary between transient derivation (stage) and canonical truth (store)."
    },
    {
      "id": "P004",
      "type": "defines",
      "source": "OPS: lift",
      "target": "Graph.edges",
      "direction": "WAL.store → Graph.edges",
      "evidence": "lift iterates k.wal.store to create Temporal edges between consecutive events.",
      "confidence": 1.0,
      "related_invariants": [
        "INV-003"
      ],
      "notes": "Temporal causality is derived deterministically from the store order."
    },
    {
      "id": "P005",
      "type": "defines",
      "source": "OPS: lift",
      "target": "Graph.edges",
      "direction": "WAL.store → Graph.edges",
      "evidence": "lift uses ht[e.wld] to create Causal edges within the same world.",
      "confidence": 1.0,
      "related_invariants": [
        "INV-004"
      ],
      "notes": "Causal edges link events within the same world context."
    },
    {
      "id": "P006",
      "type": "constrains",
      "source": "INV: causal-scope",
      "target": "Graph.edges",
      "direction": "causal-scope → Graph.edges",
      "evidence": "forall e in Graph.edges: e.typ == Causal -> g.nodes[e.src].wld == g.nodes[e.dst].wld",
      "confidence": 1.0,
      "related_invariants": [
        "INV-004"
      ],
      "notes": "Causal edges cannot cross world boundaries."
    },
    {
      "id": "P007",
      "type": "invariant",
      "source": "OPS: append",
      "target": "WAL.store",
      "direction": "append → WAL.store",
      "evidence": "append increments clk and uses len(store) for idx, ensuring monotonicity.",
      "confidence": 0.9,
      "related_invariants": [
        "INV-001"
      ],
      "notes": "Append preserves the monotonic-clock invariant."
    },
    {
      "id": "P008",
      "type": "invariant",
      "source": "OPS: commit",
      "target": "WAL.store",
      "direction": "commit → WAL.store",
      "evidence": "commit increments clk for each staged event before appending to store.",
      "confidence": 0.9,
      "related_invariants": [
        "INV-001"
      ],
      "notes": "Commit preserves the monotonic-clock invariant."
    },
    {
      "id": "P009",
      "type": "event_fact_candidate",
      "source": "OPS: lift",
      "target": "Graph",
      "direction": "WAL.store → Graph",
      "evidence": "lift(k) returns a Graph derived deterministically from k.wal.store.",
      "confidence": 0.85,
      "related_invariants": [
        "INV-005"
      ],
      "notes": "Graph is a pure, deterministic projection of the WAL store."
    }
  ],
  "key_invariants_detected": [
    "INV-001",
    "INV-002",
    "INV-003",
    "INV-004",
    "INV-005"
  ],
  "authority_boundaries": [
    "WAL.stage → WAL.store"
  ],
  "open_questions": [
    "How does branch() affect the causal history of existing events in WAL.store?",
    "Is the 'clean' function strictly deterministic across all possible Graph states or only those produced by 'lift'?",
    "What happens to Causal edges if a world is discarded or overwritten?"
  ]
}
